citation: Tomczak, S. (2016). Polish Companies Bankruptcy [Dataset]. UCI Machine Learning Repository. https://doi.org/10.24432/C5F600
verified: 2026-10-25 - definitions copied verbatim from the UCI page (X1..X64). Column AttrN == XN, confirmed by (a) all five files' row and bankruptcy counts matching the published counts exactly and (b) value behaviour matching definitions (Attr29 log scale, median 4.2; Attr21 sales growth, median 1.12; Attr2 leverage, median 0.45; Attr55 an absolute amount).
sampling_note: Per the source: bankrupt companies were analysed over 2000-2012; still-operating companies over 2007-2013. The two classes were drawn from DIFFERENT calendar windows. The source describes the firms only as 'Polish companies' (no sector given on the UCI page).
quirks: Attr9 and Attr36 have the same published definition wording ('sales / total assets' vs 'total sales / total assets') but are different columns (correlation 0.10 in the 5-year file); the definitions do not explain the difference.
Attr48 and Attr49 are labelled 'EBITDA (profit on operating activities - depreciation)' - subtracting depreciation is not standard EBITDA; recorded verbatim.

Attr55 is an absolute amount (working capital), not a ratio; values such as -999 or 98 are plausible real amounts, so the generic sentinel heuristic (which lists -999/98 as candidate codes) can misfire on this column.
Attr52 definition has an unbalanced parenthesis in the source; recorded verbatim.

Attr24 'gross profit (in 3 years) / total assets' does not state whether the 3 years precede or follow the statement date; if following, it would carry outcome information. Unresolved - check the original paper (Zieba, Tomczak & Tomczak 2016) before treating as clean.
No company identifier: the same firm may appear in more than one horizon file; this cannot be checked.

features.Attr5: [(cash + short-term securities + receivables - short-term liabilities) / (operating expenses - depreciation)] * 365
features.Attr8: book value of equity / total liabilities
features.Attr11: (gross profit + extraordinary items + financial expenses) / total assets
features.Attr22: profit on operating activities / total assets
features.Attr27: profit on operating activities / financial expenses
features.Attr41: total liabilities / ((profit on operating activities + depreciation) * (12/365))
features.Attr43: rotation receivables + inventory turnover in days
features.Attr48: EBITDA (profit on operating activities - depreciation) / total assets
features.Attr49: EBITDA (profit on operating activities - depreciation) / sales
features.Attr57: (current assets - inventory - short-term liabilities) / (sales - gross profit - depreciation)
